title: Less is More: Concise Retrieval and Critic-based Re-ranking for Composed Image Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.27538v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Zero-shot composed image retrieval (ZS-CIR) aims to retrieve a target image based on a reference image and modification text. Recent approaches commonly rely on large vision-language models to generate target image captions for retrieval. However, these captions may include redundant semantic details, introducing noise when retrieving the target image and leading to suboptimal retrieval results. To address this issue, we propose Less-is-More CIR, a two-stage training-free framework that combines Concise Retrieval and Critic Re-ranking. In the first stage, concise target-oriented captions are generated that preserve only the most discriminative modification semantics, thereby reducing semantic noise in the retrieval. In the second stage, a critic re-rank module further evaluates the retrieved candidates from the perspectives of modification consistency and reference preservation. translated_title: 少即是多：面向组合图像检索的简洁检索与基于评价者的重排序
translated_abstract: 零样本组合图像检索（ZS-CIR）旨在根据参考图像和修改文本来检索目标图像。近期的方法通常依赖大型视觉-语言模型生成目标图像的描述用于检索。然而，这些描述可能包含冗余的语义细节，在检索目标图像时引入噪声，导致检索结果欠佳。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Less-is-More CIR，这是一个无需训练的两阶段框架，结合了简洁检索与评价者重排序。在第一阶段，生成简洁的面向目标的描述，仅保留最具区分性的修改语义，从而减少检索中的语义噪声。在第二阶段，评价者重排序模块从修改一致性和参考保持两个角度进一步评估检索到的候选图像。大量实验证明了该方法的有效性和……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的两阶段框架Less-is-More CIR，第一阶段通过生成仅保留关键修改语义的简洁描述来降低检索噪声，第二阶段利用评价者重排序模块从修改一致性和参考保持两方面筛选候选图像，从而提升零样本组合图像检索的效果。
en_tdlr: A training-free two-stage framework, Less-is-More CIR, that generates concise target-oriented captions preserving only the most discriminative modification semantics to reduce retrieval noise, combined with a critic re-ranking module that evaluates candidates from the perspectives of modification consistency and reference preservation for zero-shot composed image retrieval.
